selectionEntries.name: Battle Sisters

rules.name: Munitorum Cherub
rules.description: Once per battle, after selecting targets for this unit’s weapons, you may ‘use the blessed ammunition’ and select a model in this unit. If you do, for each attack made for the selected model this turn, reroll a failed Hit and Wound roll for that attack. (Use the Cherub models to note when a unit has yet to use this ability and remove them after the ability is used.)

selectionEntries.comment: BATTLE SISTERS LOADOUT PASS: Sister Superior is represented directly with a ranged weapon list and Chainsword / Power Sword melee list. Battle Sisters 2-8 are the ordinary Boltgun block. Battle Sisters 9-10 are canonical specialist models, defaulting to Storm Bolter and able to select the five other free special/heavy weapon options. Munitorum Cherub is unit-level Paid Wargear with full rule text.

modifiers.value: Battle Sisters has more than one Leader attached. It may have only one externally attached Leader. Remove or move one of the attached Leaders. An Imagifier may still be included under Additional Leader.

selectionEntries.comment:
SOFT OTHER COPY COSTS. Permanent required accounting entry. Aggregates +20 Points per copy of every native non-Rare Other unit beyond the selected Game Size's 1/2/3 normal allowance.

sharedSelectionEntries.comment: NESTED COUNTLESS LEADER: Imagifier is not a root Leader selection. Battle Sisters, Dominions, and Retributors expose it through an Additional Leader box. This directly represents its ability to join those units even when a non-IMAGIFIER leader is already attached.

catalogue.comment:
PHASE 0.1 STRUCTURAL SHELL
Scope intentionally limited to Unit Name, Unit Class, Unit Category, Points Cost, and Attachments. Imagifier uses the nested Additional Leader pattern. Loadouts, Additional Copy Costs, unit-size UI, ratio restrictions, and other non-attachment list-building mechanics are intentionally deferred.

PHASE 0.2 LEADER LOADOUT PASS
Equipment added only for Canoness, Palatine, Dogmata, Imagifier, and Dialogus. Imagifier remains nested as Additional Leader. No non-Leader loadouts added.

PHASE 0.3 BATTLE SISTERS LOADOUT PASS
Added equipment only for Battle Sisters. Existing Leader loadouts and Imagifier Additional Leader structure are preserved.

PHASE 0.4 ELITES / DOMINIONS / PARAGONS LOADOUT PASS
Added loadouts for Sisters Repentia, Celestine, Hospitaller, Celestian Sacresants, Dominions, Paragon Warsuits, and Arco-Flagellants. Sisters Novitiates remain intentionally untouched.

PHASE 0.5 ZEPHYRIM / VEHICLES / RETRIBUTORS LOADOUT PASS
Corrected Repentia Superior placement. Added Zephyrim, Sororitas Rhino, Immolator, Penitent Engines, Mortifiers, Exorcist, Castigator, and Retributors. Seraphim remain intentionally untouched.

PHASE 0.5A ZEPHYRIM SOURCE CONFIRMATION
Zephyrim presentation confirmed against the clarified source: Zephyrim Superior is the free Plasma Pistol / Pennant model; Zephyrim 2-5 retain Bolt Pistol + Power Sword with paid Hand Flamer / Inferno Pistol upgrades. Seraphim remain untouched.

PHASE 0.5B PAID WARGEAR / RETRIBUTOR UI FIX
All direct Paid Wargear entries now use optional max-1 selection groups instead of quantity spinners. Retributors 2-5 no longer auto-select a heavy weapon, preventing the roster from opening in an illegal 4x default state.

PHASE 0.5C RETRIBUTOR NONE / VALIDATION UI
Retributors 2-5 now use optional 0/1 heavy-weapon lists, allowing New Recruit to display its built-in (None) state. A hidden semantic category counts real heavy-weapon assignments and a custom error explains when fewer than four models are configured.

REV9 CONSTRUCTIVE ERROR + UNIVERSAL SYSTEM MIGRATION
Adepta Sororitas now use Game System revision 11. Added the standard Additional Copy Costs subsystem for all 14 native non-Rare Other units, including Configuration safeguards and per-unit reminder links. Canoness, Palatine, Dogmata, and Dialogus use constructive missing-attachment validation; Battle Sisters, Dominions, and Retributors use constructive external-Leader host limits; Canoness, Celestine, and Hospitaller use constructive Rare limits. Imagifier remains a nested Countless Additional Leader and does not consume the external Leader association slot. Retributor heavy-weapon validation is preserved unchanged. Sisters Novitiates and Seraphim remain intentionally without loadout implementations.
